testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST contain data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='nav-link-apps', data-testid='app-card-groovsesh', data-testid='download-modal-app-store-button', data-testid='instrument-tab-piano', data-testid='piano-key-C4', data-testid='add-to-cart-groovpuck-bt', data-testid='login-submit-button')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_requirements: All body text must use high contrast slate-200 / slate-300 on dark slate-950/900 background. Cyan buttons must use dark text #030712 for max readability.
testing_and_accessibility.aria_labels: All interactive canvas, synth pads, sound switches, and modal dialogs must have explicit aria-label and role attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain the dark professional recording studio aesthetic across every single page and component.
Use glowing cyan (#00F0FF) and electric blue (#0066FF) as primary accents with subtle neon magenta for badges and highlights.
Ensure the interactive instrument playground uses real browser Web Audio API sound synthesis so clicking piano keys, drum pads, or guitar strings produces clear, pleasant musical tones.
Implement full e-commerce functionality for the shop: product filtering, cart drawer with quantity adjustments, promo codes, mock Stripe checkout modal, and order confirmation toast via Sonner.
Include full user account experience: login/register modal/page, user profile dashboard showing connected GroovLabz apps, synced cloud sessions, purchase history, and active hardware registration.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, and links include data-testid attributes for automated testing.
